about: Named Pipes: the pipe names SAT recognises in \\.\pipe\ on Windows and the Unix domain socket paths it recognises on Linux, read by name only. A pattern ignores case; * stands for any text and {pid} for the decimal ID of the process that created the pipe, which SAT names from the process list. In service, {1} is the text the first * stood for. platform is windows or linux; a rule without one applies to both. category veeam and database are the names Show: Veeam pipes keeps; runtime names the program behind a name. observed_on names the machine a name was read on, and is empty for a name taken from the product's documentation. Veeam's Linux socket names (Veeam Agent for Linux, veeamtransport on Linux proxies and repositories) are to be read on a lab machine and added here; until then a Linux socket held by a process whose name starts with veeam is marked as a Veeam socket without a rule.
